title: Right-horn and vertex-fiber comparisons for cone unstraightening
statement:
Use the small simplicial sets and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the projective diagram category and ordinary adjunction $L_S\dashv U_S$ of [lem-coef-cone-presheaf-adjunction], and the cosimplicial pinched cubes $Q^\bullet$ and maps $Q^m\to\Delta^m$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching]. Let $S$ be any small simplicial set, without a quasicategory assumption. For every $\sigma:\Delta^n\to S$ and $0<i\leq n$, $n\geq1$, the map
$$L_S(\Lambda_i^n\xrightarrow{\sigma}S)\longrightarrow L_S(\Delta^n\xrightarrow{\sigma}S)$$
is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence. For any map $u:T\to S$ and any enriched presheaf $F:\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$, the simplexwise cone formula gives a natural isomorphism
$$u^*U_S(F)\cong U_T(F\circ\mathfrak C[u]^{\mathrm{op}}),$$
compatible with composition of base maps and natural in $F$. For a vertex $s$ of $S$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$(U_SF)_s\cong\operatorname{Sing}_Q(F(s)),\qquad (\operatorname{Sing}_Q K)_m=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(Q^m,K).$$
The simplex operators on $\operatorname{Sing}_Q K$ are precomposition with those of $Q^\bullet$. If $K$ is Kan then $\operatorname{Sing}_Q K$ is Kan and the natural map $K\to\operatorname{Sing}_Q K$ induced by $Q^m\to\Delta^m$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. These fiber comparisons are natural in maps between Kan complexes.
